paragraph1.text1: Welcome to Magic Spell! Cast a magic spell to get a random multiplier. If the multiplier is equal to or higher than your payout, you win! But if the magic fails, you lose and the round ends.
paragraph1.text2: Watch the wizard do magic and see your multiplier. On the top side, you can see the results of past rounds to help you choose your next bet.

paragraph2.text2: Set your payout to choose how much you want to win.
paragraph2.text3: Choose your bet and payout, then click the bet button to start the magic spell.
paragraph2.text4: If the magic fails, you lose your bet. If it works, coins will appear in the magic circle and you win!

paragraph4.title: Last Results
paragraph4.text1: The Last Results section shows multipliers from previous rounds. You can use these past numbers to help you make better betting choices.
